name: eve-map-assistant-dsh
description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) profile bundle for the EVE Static Map Planner MCP bridge. Injects one streamable-http MCP client (id: mcp-eve-map) pointing at http://127.0.0.1:27892/mcp and surfaces map tools to the model as mcp__eve-static-map__*. Compatible with EVE Map Assistant Plugin 0.5.1 / EVE Static Map Planner 1.0.0.
